test_execution: Single-process Node built-ins only; no network or child processes. Each test_file is also runnable directly with node.
demo_description: Deterministic runnable Node program emitting self-contained synthetic result JSON with fixed seed, timestamps and illustrative ratings.

separate_integration_checks.requirements: Server checks use temporary loopback sockets. Browser checks additionally require the pinned development-only Playwright package and an installed Chrome/Chromium. Neither belongs in the isolated gate test_files.
